thread:
anya: Quick heads-up: I'm proposing a change to how deep links land users. Idea is to prefer a canonical resource URL + clear breadcrumb and not auto-toggle UI chrome. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc (comment-only)

olivia: Curious: do we make the canonical URL include the workspace slug or the numeric id? slugs are friendlier for sharing.

hyun: prefer slug for UX. But note: slugs can change (rename). We should support stable id in the background and redirect slugs -> id server-side.

jamal: routing concern: the back button needs to restore the previous rail expansion state when users navigate within the app. We shouldn't lose history entries for minor panel opens.

anya: proposal: canonical paths look like /w/:workspaceSlug/models/:modelId and model version as /w/:workspaceSlug/models/:modelId/v/:versionId. Query params reserved for filters and view-mode only.

rachel: UI behavior question: when opening a deep link to a nested view, expand the left rail group but DON'T shift keyboard focus to it. Instead, focus main H1 and expose a skip link to nav.

ada-a11y: +1. Also recommend an aria-live region for breadcrumb changes so screen reader users hear the current location when landing. When the rail auto-expands, announce "Navigation expanded to Models". Use role="status" with polite politeness.

olivia: copy tweak: breadcrumb pieces should read as human phrases: "Acme / Models / T-Rex (v1.2)". For very long names show ellipsis and full name on hover and via accessible name.

hyun: engineering note: we can implement slug redirects plus a small client-side nav map that ties path patterns to nav group IDs. Example mapping:

```json
{
  "/w/:ws/models": "nav-models",
  "/w/:ws/models/:modelId": "nav-models",
  "/w/:ws/deployments/:id": "nav-deployments"
}
```

This lets the nav component decide whether to expand a section on mount.

jamal: for analytics, please add source param on initial load: ?_src=deep_link or push a page.view event with load_source. That helps de-dupe direct bookmarks vs in-app nav.

eng-bot: Deploy queue: router-shim branch created by hyun. CI passed. (reaction: :rocket:)

anya: action items: hyun to stub slug->id redirect; rachel + ada-a11y to write breadcrumb and announcement copy; jamal to draft QA for back-button + deep-link history; olivia to update Figma. I'll assemble a short spec doc and link tickets.

olivia: I'll add visual microcopy for the permalink menu on hover and the tooltip text.

hyun: ETA for spike: 1 week for redirects + nav map. I'll open PRs and link here.

anya: Great — thanks team. Leaving this thread open for any quick follow-ups.
